images.scene: SCENE: Two identical old paper wall calendars hanging side by side on a bare plaster wall, each a plain grid of empty day squares. The calendar on the LEFT is worn and used, nearly every square crossed out with a heavy pencil X, its bottom corner curled. The calendar on the RIGHT is pristine and completely unmarked, brand new. No month names, no readable words, no letters anywhere. Hard side light, long shadows on the plaster.

SCENE: Two old paper wall calendars hanging side by side on a bare plaster wall. The left one is worn and used with days crossed out, printed with the single clear word AGOSTO in large capital letters at its top. The right one is pristine and unmarked, printed with the single clear word SETEMBRO in large capital letters at its top. Both words must be spelled exactly and printed crisply. Hard side light.
